    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AlertBox
    Utility class for displaying alerts and confirmation dialogs.
    Game
    Represents the game state for Battleship.
    GameController
    Main game controller for Battleship.
    GameNotifier
    Class that notifies game events to observers (Observer Pattern).
    GameObserver
    Interface for the Observer design pattern.
    GameState
    Represents the complete state of a Battleship game.
    GameView
    Main game view where shots are fired.
    HelloApplication
    Initializer - It opens the information-view.
    InformationController
    Controller for the information view (main menu) of Battleship.
    InformationView
     
    InvalidPositionException
    Exception thrown when a board position is invalid.
    InvalidShotException
    Exception thrown when a shot is invalid.
    MachineView
    View for displaying both boards for verification purposes.
    Matrix
    Represents the 10x10 game board matrix for Battleship.
    Matrix.State
    Possible states for a cell on the board.
    PlacementController
    Controller for the ship placement view.
    PlacementView
    View for ship placement before starting the game.
    serialization
    Utility class for object serialization and game file management.
    Ship
    Represents a ship in the Battleship game.
    Ship.Direction
    Ship direction on the board.
    Ship.Type
    Ship types according to specifications.
    ShipFactory
    Factory class for creating ships (Factory Design Pattern).
    ShotQueue
    Queue data structure to store the game's shot history.
